main_text.p: scribit in L. paterfam. 28; D. de reb.auct. ind.poss. ubi pupillus, cui substitutum à patre fuerat, paterna quidem hereditate se abstinebat, adventiciam autem amplectebatur. Et cum eius impuberis mortui substitutus heres esset, quærebatur an idcirco creditoribus paternis actio in istum danda esset, quòd unum esset testamentum. Respondetur autem: eò non dari, quia duæ sunt hereditates inter se dissi millimæ, diuersissimisque ex fontibus promanantes. Huius etiam generis controuersia fuit Luctatii consulis, prætorisque Valerii, cui iudex Ca-la-

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment: "scribit" (the initial letter is not fully visible). "dissi millimæ": the printed line break after "difsi" has no hyphen, so the word is uncertain; it is copied as printed with the long s corrected. "Ca-la-": the line breaks are as printed, with the last fragment at the foot of the page. The running head is decorative and could not be read. Pen marks in the margins are handwriting and were not transcribed.
